text:
Camille: FYI — spotted a new model drop in partner bucket: gs://thirdparty/models/hippo-lite-2/v1. We need a quick clearance check before we add it to the serving catalog.

Rahul: Thanks. Do we have a model card or license file with it? path?

Camille: There's a model_card.md and a LICENSE.txt in the repo root. LICENSE looks like a CC BY-NC 4.0 variant + an extra clause about derivative redistribution. Not exactly standard. :thinking_face:

Tess: Can you paste the header of the model_card? small snippet might help legal triage.

Camille: Sure — paste below:

Camille: ```
Name: Hippo Lite 2
Authors: Hippo Research Lab
Recommended usage: non-commercial research and demo only
Attribution: "Hippo Research Lab" required on product pages
Known tokenizer quirks: emoji sequences split as separate tokens, leading spaces preserved in <bos> mode
```

Rahul: Tokenizer quirk is fine (we can patch our wrapper). The non-commercial + redistribution restriction is rough — blocks hosted usage unless we have an enterprise agreement.

LegalBot: AUTO-ANALYSIS: License contains Non-Commercial (NC) AND Redistribution restriction => Classification: RESTRICTED. Recommended action: legal review + gating. :warning:

Sam: For serving readiness: we should add a manifest entry with license metadata and a blocking flag so CI prevents server image builds for restricted models. Example manifest patch: 

Sam: ```yaml
model_name: hippo-lite-2
version: v1
weights_path: gs://thirdparty/models/hippo-lite-2/v1/weights.pt
tokenizer: hippo-tokenizer-v2
license: "CC-BY-NC-4.0 + no-redistribution"
license_status: restricted
attribution: "Hippo Research Lab"
serving_allowed: false  # CI will block until legal clears
```

Tess: s/serving_allowed/approved_for_hosting/ maybe? we use that flag in infra. Also include a recommended attribution snippet to show product teams.

Sam: Good call. Updated snippet: 

Sam: ```yaml
approved_for_hosting: false
attribution_text: "Hippo Research Lab — used under CC-BY-NC, attribution required"
```

Rahul: Once legal gives green, infra can flip approved_for_hosting and deploy a dedicated sandbox cluster for evals (no public hosting). Also need a tokenizer wrapper fix for emoji behavior — I'll open a PR against our tokenizer-adapters repo.

Camille: Logged tasks: 1) Legal review request (assigned Tess) 2) PR for tokenizer adapter (assigned Rahul) 3) Manifest + CI gating change (assigned Sam) 4) Short docs for product about attribution text (assigned Camille).

Tess: I'll ping LegalOps and attach the model_card + LICENSE. Expect initial reply in 24-48h. If LegalOps needs more context, tag me. :thumbsup:

InfraBot: CI_NOTICE: New manifest detected for hippo-lite-2 v1 with license_status: restricted. Build/deploy actions will be blocked until approved_for_hosting: true.

Rahul: I'll start the tokenizer PR now, will include unit tests for emoji sequences and leading-space handling. ETA EOD.

Camille: Thanks everyone. I'll update the internal onboarding tracker and include the manifest diff. :eyes:
